moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Heats Up
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues with multiple men's and women's matches across the UK this week, building towards the Eliminator on August 14 and the Finals on August 16.

source.l: The Hundred Official Website / Radio Times

angles.name: General excitement
angles.copy: Big hits and fast-paced action! The Hundred cricket is in full swing across the UK this week, with the Eliminator and Finals just days away. Who are you backing for glory?

angles.name: Welsh Fire focus
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are battling it out in The Hundred this week! Catch them on August 9th against Sunrisers Leeds and August 12th against London Spirit. C'mon Cymru!

angles.name: Today's match
angles.copy: It's match day in The Hundred! Today sees Birmingham Phoenix take on Sunrisers Leeds. Tune in for some explosive cricket action.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: General build-up
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser for the new football season is just over a week away! Arsenal take on Manchester City in the Community Shield, live from Cardiff. Who's lifting the first silverware?

angles.name: Cardiff host city
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing! The Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield next Sunday, August 16th, as Arsenal face Man City. Are you heading to the capital for the big game?

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated Roots Picnic festival makes its highly anticipated international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, 2026.

angles.name: Festival buzz
angles.copy: London! The iconic Roots Picnic festival lands at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend (Aug 8-9) for its first-ever international edition. Get ready for a blend of music, culture, and community!

angles.name: London local angle
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is where it's at this weekend! The legendary Roots Picnic festival is making its UK debut right here in London. Who are you hoping to catch?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's collaboration 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK number-one single of all time, with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the summit as of July 31, 2026.

angles.name: Record breaker
angles.copy: History made on the UK Singles Chart! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 of all time. An incredible achievement!

angles.name: New music on chart
angles.copy: Beyond the record-breaker, the latest Official Singles Chart sees new entries and re-entries from Charli XCX, Robyn, Natasha Bedingfield, and Lady Gaga & Bruno Mars. What's your favourite new hit?

angles.name: New comedy special

angles.name: Weekend binge suggestion
angles.copy: Your weekend binge sorted: Ricky Gervais's 'Alley Cats' is now streaming on Netflix! What are your favourite Gervais moments?

moments.title: Happy Birthday The Edge

angles.name: U2 hits
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 65th Birthday to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge, tomorrow! From 'With or Without You' to 'Sunday Bloody Sunday', his sound is unmistakable.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Mark Knopfler

angles.name: Guitar legend
angles.copy: Next Monday, we celebrate a true guitar hero! Happy 77th Birthday to Dire Straits' iconic frontman, Mark Knopfler. What's your go-to Dire Straits track?

angles.name: Dire Straits classics
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to 'Money for Nothing', Mark Knopfler gave us some timeless tunes. Wishing him a very Happy 77th Birthday on August 12th!

angles.name: Scottish schools return
angles.copy: For our listeners in Scotland, the school bells are about to ring again, with many returning mid-August! Hope you've had a fantastic summer break!
